value.rationale: Determines a natural, non-implied sharp global phase-retrieval stability constant on the first nontrivial Hermite truncation, giving an exact benchmark for quantitative Gabor stability and identifying the global worst competitor. The constant is not a linearized estimate; its derivation needs a strict Rician convexity argument and finite-scale optimization.
